scope: Intrinsic owned keyword abilities, separately from text references and implementation tags.
rules: Release owned Tag entries establish abilities; ReferencedTag alone never confers ownership. AURA/TRIGGER_VISUAL are implementation flags, not standalone abilities.
KAR_057 and KAR_062 actively Discover in their own release text, before later dedicated tags.
KAR_004 owns SECRET, not the STEALTH of its summoned KAR_004a. KAR_006 modifies Secrets but is not a Secret.
KAR_026 summons Taunt minions, KAR_710 summons a Taunt minion, KAR_037 conditionally gains Taunt. None owns unconditional TAUNT on the source card.
KAR_063 checks Spell Damage but does not provide SPELLPOWER. KAR_712 grants immunity to its hero, not itself.
KAR_096 gains the formal START_OF_GAME keyword in11.0; unchanged engine effect is distinct from printed keyword addition.
Action descriptions such as silencing a target and general effect text are not enumerated as persistent owned keyword abilities. Raw source tags and full text remain available.
